CommunityApplications.Profile: Backuparr backs up the apps you host - media management, downloaders, media servers, network, security, home automation and server apps (the full list: https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/) - with encrypted backups sent to local storage, Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox, all set up from its web UI. The Unraid template uses the same image as every other install. Documentation: https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/ - report problems on GitHub: https://github.com/rsaturns/backuparr/issues
